article.headline: Norfolk State defeats Maryland-Eastern Shore 81-59
article.description: — Brian Moore Jr. had 22 points in Norfolk State's 81-59 victory over Maryland-Eastern Shore on Saturday night.

categories.description: Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks @ Norfolk State Spartans

event.description: Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks @ Norfolk State Spartans

keywords: Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks @ Norfolk State Spartans
article.story: NORFOLK, Va. -- — Brian Moore Jr. had 22 points in Norfolk State's 81-59 victory over Maryland-Eastern Shore on Saturday night. Moore also had seven rebounds, three steals, and four blocks for the Spartans (10-7, 1-0 Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference). Chris Fields Jr. added 14 points while shooting 5 of 8 from the field and 3 for 7 from the line while they also had five rebounds. Jalen Myers shot 5 of 6 from the field and 1 for 3 from the line to finish with 12 points. The Hawks (4-13, 0-1) were led by Chris Flippin, who posted 17 points and nine rebounds. Ketron Shaw added 10 points, nine rebounds and two blocks for Maryland-Eastern Shore. Cardell Bailey also had nine points and six rebounds. These two teams both play Monday. Norfolk State visits Delaware State and Maryland-Eastern Shore hosts Howard. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
